concerns.text: Task T018a (Resample datasets to consistent frequency) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec US1-AC3 and FR-002 require resampling before stationarity testing. Without this task, the pipeline cannot process the UK National Grid Load or NOAA data correctly, blocking US1.

Task T010a (Compute ACF, Hurst, Spectral Density for REAL series) is marked incomplete [ ]. It is a hard dependency for T019a (shuffling) and T037a (regression). The spec FR-002 and US1 require these metrics for every loaded series.

Task T010b (Compute ACF, Hurst, Spectral Density for SYNTHETIC series) is marked incomplete [ ]. It is required for T019b and T037a. Spec FR-002 and US2 mandate these metrics for synthetic series to quantify dependence.

Task T019a (Generate shuffled versions for REAL series) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-003 and Constitution Principle VII require generating [deferred] shuffled versions for *every* series to create a null distribution. This is critical for US1 and US3.

Task T019b (Generate shuffled versions for SYNTHETIC series) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-003 and Constitution Principle VII require this for synthetic series as well. Missing this breaks the null distribution requirement for US2 and US3.

Task T020 (Edge case: skip datasets < 25 points) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec 'Edge Cases' explicitly requires skipping short datasets and logging a warning. Missing this risks pipeline crashes or invalid metrics.

Task T021 (Edge case: log differencing count for unit roots) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec 'Edge Cases' requires logging the differencing count when a unit root is detected. This is needed for traceability and debugging.

Task T022 (Edge case: fallback for spectral density failure) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec 'Edge Cases' requires a variance-based fallback if spectral density fails. Missing this risks silent failures on noisy data.

Task T027 (Generate synthetic grid with N-variation) is marked incomplete [ ]. Plan and US2 require generating synthetic series with lengths {100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000}. Without this, the (H, N) grid analysis in US3 cannot proceed.

Task T029 (Baseline validity check gate) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-008 and US2 require verifying the rejection rate on H=0.5 data within a 95% Clopper-Pearson CI for 10,000 trials before proceeding. This is a hard gate for US3.
Task T033 (Unit test for hypothesis tests) is marked incomplete [ ]. US3 requires unit tests for t-test and F-test logic. Missing this leaves the core analysis logic unverified.
Task T034 (Unit test for regression/VIF) is marked incomplete [ ]. US3 requires unit tests for VIF and N_eff calculation. Missing this leaves the regression mechanism unverified.
Task T035 (Integration test for Monte Carlo loop) is marked incomplete [ ]. US3 requires an integration test for the full Monte Carlo loop. Missing this leaves the end-to-end analysis unverified.
Task T036 (Implement one-sample t-test and F-test) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-004 and US3 require implementing these tests. Missing this blocks the entire hypothesis testing phase.

Task T037 (Monte Carlo loop orchestration) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-004 and US3 require running a sufficient number of trials to ensure statistical stability. Missing this blocks error rate calculation.

Task T038 (Compare observed stats against null distribution) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec US3-AC5 requires comparing observed test statistics against the null distribution from shuffled versions. Missing this breaks the isolation of inflation.
Task T037b (Filter forbidden metrics) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-005 and US3-AC4 require excluding Max_ACF_Lag1 and spectral density from regression predictors. Missing this violates the spec.
Task T037a (Implement Linear Regression model) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-005 and US3 require regressing error rates against Hurst exponent. Missing this blocks the core research output.

Task T037c (Calculate VIF and N_eff in regression) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-005 and US3 require calculating VIF and N_eff to validate the mechanism of failure. Missing this blocks the analysis.
Task T039 (Implement visualizations) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-006 and US3 require ACF plots, scatter plots, and QQ-plots. Missing this blocks the output requirements.
Task T039b (Implement VIF curves visualization) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec FR-006 and US3 require VIF curves. Missing this blocks a specific visualization requirement.
Task T040 (Performance validation and runtime enforcement) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec SC-004 and US3 require measuring runtime and enforcing the 6-hour limit. Missing this risks CI failure.

Task T041 (Output final summary) is marked incomplete [ ]. Spec US3-AC2 and US3-AC3 require outputting final summary with regression slopes, p-values, VIF, N_eff, and error rates. Missing this blocks the final deliverable.
Task T042 (Documentation updates) is marked incomplete [ ]. Plan requires quickstart.md and README.md updates. Missing this blocks the documentation requirement.
Task T043 (Code cleanup and refactoring) is marked incomplete [ ]. Plan requires memory efficiency (< 7 GB RAM). Missing this risks resource exhaustion.
Task T044 (Performance optimization) is marked incomplete [ ]. Plan requires vectorizing Monte Carlo loops to meet 6h runtime. Missing this risks CI failure.
Task T045 (Contract test suite) is marked incomplete [ ]. Plan requires running contract tests to verify schema compliance. Missing this leaves data integrity unverified.
Task T046 (Security hardening) is marked incomplete [ ]. Plan requires verifying no API keys are hardcoded. Missing this risks security violations.
Task T047 (Quickstart validation) is marked incomplete [ ]. Plan requires validating quickstart.md for end-to-end reproducibility. Missing this blocks the reproducibility requirement.
